verdict.rationale: Fellow's own feature page says teams can record without a visible bot by capturing audio directly from the desktop, across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Slack Huddles and in-person meetings. It also says every meeting is transcribed into a full, searchable transcript. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of botless desktop capture, in-depth setup docs, and explicit confirmation that external participants see no indicator.
